strings.policy.global-baseline.title: Global privacy baseline
strings.policy.global-baseline.summary: Rianell stores health logs on your device by default. Cloud backup, anonymised research contribution, and on-device AI are optional and require separate consent. You can Exporter or Supprimer your data at any time.
strings.policy.eu-gdpr.title: EEA & UK - GDPR
strings.policy.eu-gdpr.summary: Health data is special-category data under GDPR Art. 9. We rely on your explicit consent to process it locally and for optional cloud, research, and AI features. You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection.
strings.policy.data-subject-rights.title: Your data rights
strings.policy.data-subject-rights.summary: You may Télécharger a Copier of your health logs, request correction, withdraw consent, or Supprimer local and cloud data from Paramètres. Contact the operator for formal data-subject requests.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us-ca.title: California (CCPA/CPRA)
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us-ca.summary: We do not sell personal information. California residents have rights to know, Supprimer, and correct personal information. Health logs are consumer wellness data, not HIPAA-covered provider records unless you use Rianell under a healthcare BAA.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us.title: United States - other states
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us.summary: Consumer wellness self-tracking is generally outside HIPAA unless you are a covered entity or business associate. State privacy laws may grant access and deletion rights similar to our global baseline.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-au.title: Australia
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-au.summary: Australian Privacy Principles apply to personal information we hold. You may access and correct your data and complain to the OAIC.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-br.title: Brazil (LGPD)
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-br.summary: LGPD grants confirmation, access, correction, anonymisation, portability, deletion, and information about sharing. Health data may receive heightened protection.

strings.content.bodyRegion.head: Head
strings.tutorial.slide0.body: Do you want to use AI Analysis (patterns, insights, summary) and Goals & targets? You can turn this on later in Paramètres.
strings.tutorial.slide1.body: Track your health daily: log Symptômes, food, exercise, Douleur areas, and more in one place.
strings.tutorial.slide2.body: View Logs shows your history. AI Analysis finds patterns and correlations across your data.
strings.tutorial.slide3.body: In Paramètres, you can create an account to Enregistrer your data encrypted in the cloud and Partager between devices.
strings.tutorial.slide3.openData: Use open data for training AI - when on, AI uses open shared data; when off, AI uses only your personal data. Used for personalised AI analysis and advice.
strings.tutorial.slide3.accountBody: Create an account to Enregistrer your data encrypted in the cloud and sync between devices.
strings.tutorial.slide4.anonHint: Partager your anonymised data to help improve AI models
strings.tutorial.slide4.openDataHint: Use anonymised data pool for AI training (requires 90+ days of data). Used for personalised AI analysis and advice.
strings.tutorial.slide5.body: Accessibilité options help you make the app easier to read and use from day one. You can change these anytime later in Paramètres → Accessibilité.
strings.tutorial.slide5.largeTextHint: Quick preset for bigger text across the app.
strings.tutorial.slide5.ttsHint: Tap buttons/controls to hear their label read aloud.
strings.tutorial.slide5.readModeHint: Also reads when a control gets focus (keyboard and assistive navigation).
strings.tutorial.slide6.body: Set Goals & targets with the target button next to Paramètres. Choose daily targets for steps, hydration, Sommeil score, and good days per week.
strings.tutorial.slide6.progress: Your progress and "Last 7 days vs targets" appear on the Home tab so you can see how you're doing.
strings.tutorial.slide7.body: You're all set. Fermer to start logging, try Demo Mode, or create an account to Enregistrer your data in the cloud.
strings.common.consent.healthDataBody: Rianell enregistre vos symptômes et bilans sur votre appareil. Ce sont des données de santé sensibles au sens du RGPD. En continuant, vous donnez votre consentement explicite (art. 9(2)(a)) au traitement local pour faire fonctionner l’application. La sauvegarde cloud, la contribution anonymisée et l’IA sur l’appareil nécessitent des options séparées.
strings.common.consent.healthDataContact: Contact : jan.andersson@rianell.com. Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour vos droits.
strings.common.read.mode.focus.hint: Activé : les contrôles focalisés sont aussi lus à voix haute (clavier et navigation assistée).
strings.settings.accessibility.plainLanguageHint: Activé : les résumés IA utilisent des mots plus simples (niveau B1). Vos notes de journal ne sont jamais réécrites.
strings.settings.accessibility.chartPaletteHint: Les couleurs des graphiques sont distinctes du thème de l’application.
